title: Fix Design App Select Tool Setting Bar Names
description: Fix the names and IDs in the Design app select tool setting bar. Current implementation uses incorrect i18n keys and element IDs that don't match the expected structure (mode.additive, mode.subtractive, mode.intersect, shape.rectangular, shape.lasso, navigation.hand). Also missing intersect, rectangular, lasso, and hand toggles in the DesignSelectSettings component.
summary: Fixed Design app select tool setting bar names. Updated DesignSelectSettings element IDs from flat naming (select.additive/subtractive) to hierarchical naming (select.mode.additive, select.mode.subtractive, select.mode.intersect, select.shape.rectangular, select.shape.lasso, select.navigation.hand). Added missing intersect, rectangular, lasso, and hand toggles. Imported IntersectIcon. Fixed merge conflict in Sketchpad.tsx toolbar condition. All i18n keys match en.json and de.json structures.
